payload.text: **0081, filed at 4a8f5c8 (vc found and measured it): assert_identifier's devbin-own list is stale, so project.root_var can overwrite DEVBIN_RUN_ID, DEVBIN_RUN_STAMP, DEVBIN_CLI_TASK and DEVBIN_RUN_REFERENT with the project root.** Who builds it is not ruled. The fix wants an arm holding the list against the dispatcher's real exports, reusing WP-02's env-dump shape, not only a longer list. Not yet driven: options.<name>.export into the same names, and what a path-valued stamp does to a gate's run log. The probe is in vc's scratchpad (clobber/tests/unit/zz-probe.bats).
